steps: Visit the JHASCOFISH office during office hours to request a hard copy of the application form.
Fill in all mandatory fields in the application form and attach copies of all mandatory documents.
Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the JHASCOFISH office.
Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the JHASCOFISH office.
parsed.department: Department of Animal Husbandry and Fisheries, Government of Jharkhand
